subject: general
question: Which initiative promotes rooftop solar installations for households?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana** is an initiative launched to promote **rooftop solar installations** for households.
 
• This scheme aims to encourage the adoption of **solar energy** at the household level, thereby contributing to **sustainable energy solutions**.
 
• Under this initiative, households can install **solar panels** on their rooftops to generate electricity for their own use.
 
• The scheme is designed to reduce the **dependency on conventional electricity** and promote the use of **renewable energy sources**.
 
• It provides various incentives, such as **subsidies**, to make solar panel installations more affordable for households.
 
• By adopting this scheme, households can significantly reduce their **electricity bills** and contribute to **environmental conservation**.
 
• This initiative aligns with India's commitment to achieving its **renewable energy targets** and combating **climate change**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **URJA Mission**__

 __
 
• **URJA Mission** is a program that focuses on improving the **energy efficiency** and **distribution infrastructure** across India.
 
• This initiative aims to ensure **efficient power supply** to urban and rural areas by addressing issues in the energy distribution network.
 
 
 
• **PM-KUSUM**__
 __
 
• The **PM-KUSUM** scheme (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan) primarily focuses on **solar energy solutions** for farmers.
 
• It promotes **solar-powered irrigation pumps** and aims to reduce farmers’ dependence on diesel and electricity for irrigation.
 
• The scheme also encourages farmers to install **solar power plants** to sell surplus electricity to the grid.
 
 
 
• **Solar India**__
 
 
• **Solar India** refers to India’s broader mission to become a global leader in **solar energy production**.
 
• India has launched ambitious programs under this umbrella, such as the **National Solar Mission**, which aims to achieve **100 GW of solar capacity** by 2022.
 
• This initiative involves promoting large-scale **solar power projects** and installations across the country.
